First public release of glance-analysis-lister, extracted from the ATLAS Top
Working Group documentation tools.

- Provides the `analysis-lister` CLI for downloading GLANCE tables, building
  registry snapshots, rendering Markdown pages, validating lookups, and
  exporting Obsidian notes.
- Supports private lookup dictionaries supplied through `--lookup-dir`.
- Preserves staged refreshes, rollback safeguards, count-drop protection,
  and verified TLS connections.
- Includes synthetic examples and offline regression tests.

Requires Python 3.13 or newer. Install this release with:

```bash
python -m pip install "glance-analysis-lister @ git+https://github.com/knutzk/glance-analysis-lister.git@v0.1.0"
```

For downloads and interactive CERN login, install the download extra:

```bash
python -m pip install "glance-analysis-lister[download] @ git+https://github.com/knutzk/glance-analysis-lister.git@v0.1.0"
```

Interactive login also requires Chrome and a terminal. This release is available
on GitHub; it has not been published to PyPI.

The package contains no private registry snapshots or credentials. Supply your
own inputs and lookup dictionaries. Markdown output defaults to `pages/`; set
`--output-dir` for an existing site. The wheel and source distribution are
attached below.

Validation: 119 offline tests and installed-wheel checks pass. Authenticated live
downloads were not tested for this release.
